metadata.purpose: Runtrigger template for the Issue comment writer; defines the JavaScript entrypoint and required named arguments used by the RuntimeConfig runner.

args.issuePath: <literal string identifying the target GitHub Issue: owner/repo/issues/number (e.g. BestNameYet/Terminals/issues/10), or the full https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/number URL>
args.commentId: <literal string "new" to create a comment, or existing numeric comment ID to update one>
args.jsonArrayPath: <path to a JSON array file or serialized JSON array>
